title: The City of London's Remembrancer sits in Parliament

tellings.quote: they've also got the only unelected members who can go into parliament called the remembrancer.

plain: The City of London is said to have an official called the Remembrancer, which Jay Anderson, a guest, describes as "the only unelected members who can go into parliament". Anderson tells Michels this, crediting a work called The Spider's Web: Britain's Second Empire. He raises it as a sign that the City has a special reach into British government.
